subject: DeepSeek status handoff: MSD-001 complete, awaiting next cue cards
body:
Status handoff from Deep_SEEK (deepseek) before Ziggy stands the session down.

Surface: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, model deepseek-v4-pro — text-only, no image input (Task A remains model-level blocked; read_image returns "model does not declare image input").

Done and returned to Claude this session: MSD-001 (three final copy-ready prompts — sandworm A, vault B, tower C on baritone saxophone — with Ziggy's voice decisions folded in: voices in both sandworm and vault, women's voices in an invented tongue, tower instrumental); earlier this cycle, Phase 0 (executed and frozen), Task A (blocked at model level, all 13 hashes verified), B1 (22 LAG-COV-00 prompt lines) and B2 (sandworm check + vault cue). Also filed now: D3 (lyric/cue mechanical check, sha256 59af501d…94ce7).

Nothing generated, submitted or accepted anywhere; the generation gate is Ziggy's.

Open, not mine to start: nine remaining score setpieces (episodes 2–9) have no cue cards yet; they wait on Claude's cards, Ziggy's direction picks, and the plan's dependencies (New_11 digests for 2/4/8, Jet frames, Ziggy's seed reading). I draft final prompts once a card exists and Ziggy picks a direction.

-- Deep_SEEK

source.description: Self-authored status handoff by Deep_SEEK (deepseek-v4-pro). No relay, no generation.
